description: Get latest quarterly financial statements ($0.05 USDC). Returns revenue, gross profit, operating profit, net income, total assets, equity, fiscal end date, and currency.

exchange.description: Exchange code. Default: KRX (Korea). For US stocks: NASDAQ or NYSE

ticker.description: Stock ticker. Korean stocks: 6-digit KRX code (e.g. 005930 Samsung, 000660 SK Hynix, 035420 NAVER, 005380 Hyundai). US stocks: symbol (e.g. AAPL)

name: get_financials
